Yes.
No.
> Serph and the party feel hungry.
> They grew weak from hunger.
Which boss do you want to fight?

Ravana.
Hari Hara.

Are you feeling any better?
Well, is there anything you would
like to know, sir?
Anything else, sir?

No.
About the Tribes.
About the Junkyard.
About the war.
I see.

They are the 6 major groups who
divide and rule the Junkyard.
"The Embryon" is one such group.
We all follow you, sir.

That is the name of this world
we live in.
It is divided into seven areas:
Muladhara, Svadhisthana, Manipura,
Anahata, Vishudha, Ajna, and
Sahasrara.

The Tribes of the Junkyard are all
fighting to rule over the other
Tribes.
The triumphant group will be
allowed into Nirvana.

The Karma Temple is located in the
Sahasrara area in the very center
of the Junkyard, sir.

Did the Temple send that light?
Why would they not simply issue a
summons?

Devour others to survive and
steal their power...
That seems different from simply
killing our enemies.

I am not as hungry when I hear Sera
singing.

When I hear Sera's song, I forget
about my hunger.
Sir...?

Why do we need to kill each other
in order to earn a place in paradise?

...*cough* Never mind.
Forget I said anything.
*sigh* ...Who do we have to kill next?

I don't mean any disrespect, sir...
But, the way we live right now...
It doesn't make sense to me.
What about the laws of nature?
I can't really explain it.
*sigh* ...Who do we have to kill next?

I don't mean any disrespect, sir...
But, the way we live right now...
It doesn't make sense to me.
What about the laws of nature?
I can't really explain it.
We've killed so many...

I know it wasn't your decision,
sir.
It would be the same if another
Tribe had won... I just don't feel
any joy in our victory.

A-Am I going to die... again?
I'm... tired of dying... Mother...
I wonder what Nirvana's like.

Is it really worth all this
trouble?

I see that you are departing
for Svadhisthana.
The Vanguards are at an advantage.
Be careful, sir.

Were you able to learn anything
from the Vanguards?
Harley has been defeated?

Our leader is truly strong.
The Vanguards fell to only three
members of the Embryon.

The Karma Temple is the tallest
structure in the Junkyard.

Boss, did you experience the
Solar Noise at the Temple?
...I know that term refers to the sun,
though I have never seen it...

The Maribel's territory lies to
the north, in Manipura. They are
stronger than the Vanguards.
Do not relax your guard, sir.

The Citadel is a mighty fortress
in the Solids' territory of
Anahata.
It is considered impregnable.
Be ever vigilant, sir.

Do not worry about Sera's safety.
None of the other Tribes should
know she is here.

Do not worry about Sera's safety.
None of the other Tribes should
know she is here.

Do you have adequate medical
supplies, boss?

No need to remind me.
I'm low on supplies.

That is good to hear.
Be sure to heal your wounds
before going into battle.

There are many threats in battle
besides normal wounds, such as
poison and paralysis.
If your curative stock is low,
replenish at the Vendor.

Pay attention to battle formation.
Formation changes will alter your
battle strategy.

The Macca results are assessed
by the Karma Temple.
The rating is based on efficient
actions during battle.

I understand.
What does that mean?
Of course you do, sir.

During a battle, the Temple keeps
track of how many turns pass.
The fewer turns a battle lasts,
the more Macca is added to your
Tag Ring.
Kill enemies as swiftly as possible.

Though we have modified them to
harm demons...
...firearms still are not one hundred
percent effective.
They may be effective in
emergencies, however. Do not
neglect your weapon equipment.

Certain demons seem to be weak
to gunfire.
Your method of attack should take
your opponent into consideration.

I... I didn't run away!
That was part of my strategy.
If you know you're outclassed in
battle, escape and rearrange your
forces.
That's a basic tenet of warfare!
Don't blame me!
With my Atma powers...
...and my gunfire...

...we're the perfect couple!
No rival Tribe can withstand the might
of our combined powers!

Next time, they won't stand
a chance.

I'm sick and tired of this.
Why do you always get to devour
the enemies that *I* weaken!?

I need to gain power somehow.
What's wrong with that?

So you benefit from all my hard
work? No, I'm done with this!

During battle the other day,
I got reverted to human form.

I panicked...
I sooo thought I was dead for sure!

Apparently, some people have
the power to do that...
Creepy, huh?

I'm sorry, Serph.
It's all my fault that you have
to leave.
Are you going to miss it?

Just... a little.
Miss it?

A place like this holds on to
everyone's memories.
Sad memories are thorns in the
searching eye. Happy ones are
droplets of gentle life.
I remember someone telling me that
our lives are journeys across an
endless wasteland of corpses...

You're leaving a place filled with
the memories of people who lived
here.
It must feel sad, to reflect on
all the time that has passed here.

A town of rusted metal...
The leaden sky...
No, it isn't like this...
What color is the sky you remember,
Serph?

I think... it was clear blue.
A harsh, glaring yellow.

Yes, it was blue...
Not at all like this.

Please stop!
You're different than that!
You're not...

Let them keep watch.
We need to confirm information.

Let them keep watch.
We need to confirm information.

How dare they call us up like
that... At least they can fill us
in about Sera.
...They do manage the entire Junkyard.

They'd better not tell us that
they don't know anything!

Come to think of it...
I've never seen anyone with
hair like Sera's.

Gale's a bastard, making us go
through all that...

Why the hell does she like that
woman so much?
Is this about that "sad" crap?

I know I've heard that song
somewhere before...

I know I've heard that song
somewhere before...

Stop screwing around.
We need to get Sera back!

We can't keep Sera here any
longer.

I won't let anyone take her...
ever again.

The real color of the sky?
Blue, of course!

The real color of the sky?
Blue, of course!

If we get Sera back and go to
Nirvana, that should clear
everything up.

I'll kill anyone in my way--even
the Karma Temple.

Muladhara is Embryon's territory.
It is the smallest area,
sandwiched between the Vanguards'
and Maribel's sectors.
What... am I...?
Heat and I don't... sound the same.

Heat is far harsher than before.
I wonder how different I seem
to him...
Haven't I always talked like this?

And, the color of her eyes...
Where did she come from?

Now that I think about it,
everyone has been acting strangely
since receiving Atma.
Hey, Serph.

We don't need to fight Jinana any
more, right?

I finally understand what Sera
meant when she said she came here
to help us.
Her song is the only thing preventing
us from losing our grip on humanity.

I finally understand what Sera
meant when she said she came here
to help us.
Her song is the only thing preventing
us from losing our grip on humanity.

Coordinate 136...
That's where the ruins are.

They're using Sera as bait to
lure us into their trap.

I guess this is goodbye for 
awhile.

Relocating to a new base never
used to affect me, but now...
It makes me sad.
I remember blue, too...

But, how come we know that?
This sky is the only one
we've ever seen.
I remember blue, too...

But, how come we know that?
This sky is the only one
we've ever seen.

If we came to the Junkyard when we
died, do we come back to life if
we reach Nirvana?

This world is formed through
the circulation of information,
constantly refreshed by the rain.
Is something like that possible?

Serph, I think this girl will
make it!

That woman...
I do not... comprehend.

They did not even spare the time to
devour our fallen.
This assault was well planned out.

I ordered a watch on Cielo.
He may try to leave on his own.

It is becoming difficult to keep
the Tribe members under control,
especially Heat.
Have you noticed?

We have already located a new base
where we can easily hide Sera.
I deployed a scout to confirm
the area's safety. Let us wait
for him to report back.
The sky's... color?

The logical answer is obvious.
There is only one sky.
I do not comprehend.

The sky is only one color...
Why can I imagine something else?

...A dark sky burning crimson,
and a woman shedding tears.

There are things we know of which
do not exist in the Junkyard...
I never found that odd until
the Atma changed us.
The key must lie in that.

Too bad dey already know Sera
be wit' us.

Add another vote for blue.
De rainbow that appears after it stops
raining is truly beautiful.
I never seen one before, though.

Add another vote for blue.

I never seen one before, though.

I wonder what the deal is wit'
dat cat.
Dere's no other cats around.
Where did dat one come from?

Everyone is acting illogically
after being touched by the light.
What is this strange mark?

Everyone is acting illogically
after being touched by the light.
What is this strange mark?

Everyone is acting illogically
after being touched by the light.
What is this strange mark?

So this mark indicates our newly
acquired powers...

Ever since this marking appeared,
my thoughts have been...
...crowded.
I see things in my mind...
that I know I have never seen.
I agree with the group.

I may be echoing Ms. Argilla,
but I don't want to take part
in manslaughter.
Leave Muladhara to us.

I see you located Gale.
Leave Muladhara to us.

We will keep watch on Cielo.
Serph, you be careful as well.
I'm tired of seeing people die.

So Mick's finally gone?
I'm glad that everyone is okay.

Bat is finally gone, too?
Well, it's good that nobody
is hurt.

Bat is finally gone, too?
Well, it's good that nobody
is hurt.

We've all noticed what Gale was
talking about. The sun, 
for example.
We've never seen it, but it
affects us and we understand
what it is.
How could that be...?

The Solids...
They attacked us...

Who is that person you brought here,
sir? I have never seen that color
hair.

Who is that person you brought here,
sir? I have never seen that color
hair.

So, her name is Sera.
Her hair still bothers me.

I have not heard of this "Angel."
Is it related to the black-haired
girl?

I have not heard of this "Angel."
Is it related to the black-haired
girl?

Why can't this Angel find the
black-haired girl herself?
Is there some reason it needs
our help?

This is the first time I have heard
a song. What is this feeling, boss?

This is the first time I have heard
a song. What is this feeling, boss?

It hurts... but I can fight.
Please, sir... I want to be
useful.

We'll guard this base even if
the rest of Embryon relocates.
...But, please come back to visit
from time to time.

I used to have two kids, you know.
Heh, I may not look it, but--
...wait. How can that be?
I confused myself, sir.

I'm sorry...
Mick... took the girl...

Has your memory returned, sir?
Do you remember where the exit
is located?

Of course, I'm fine.
Please confirm its location.

You have recovered, then.
That is good to hear.

Take that elevator to the upper
level.

Each color marks the boundaries
of its Tribe.
